topic.source_contract: Shoreline Management Plans, NCERM and coastal-change planning evidence

facts.guard: SMP policy is not funded or delivered defence
projection is not an exact failure date

facts.planning: SMP evidence informs Coastal Change Management Areas
facts.guard: SMP direction is not planning permission

facts.ccma: local planning authorities define using best evidence
facts.guard: CCMA designation and site decision require local plan and proposal evidence
national-scale projection is not title boundary, valuation or guaranteed land loss

scope_guards: The 20 Shoreline Management Plans are strategic risk-management plans and not planning permissions.
No active intervention, hold the line, managed realignment and advance the line remain distinct policy approaches.
An SMP policy does not prove that future defence funding, maintenance or construction will occur.
NCERM projections for 2055 and 2105 are scenarios and not exact erosion dates for a parcel.
With-policy and without-future-work scenarios must not be silently merged.
Coastal Change Management Areas are local planning designations informed by the best available evidence.
NCERM and SMP geometry are not HMLR title, valuation or guaranteed land-loss boundaries.
No score or promotion is written without exact site, current SMP unit, NCERM, CCMA, defence and planning evidence.
